title: Ombudsman orders filing of graft case vs ex-Dumaguete water district GM
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Tuesday said it ordered the filing of a graft case against former Dumaguete City Water District (DCWD) General Manager Esperato Ablao Dicen for…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Tuesday said it ordered the filing of a graft case against former Dumaguete City Water District (DCWD) General Manager Esperato Ablao Dicen for alleged irregular expenditures worth over P965,000. According to the Ombudsman, it found sufficient evidence with reasonable certainty of conviction against Dicen for his alleged violation of Section 3(e) of Republic Act No. 3019 or the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act over unauthorized payments of legal fees and benefits, excessive Representation and Transportation Allowances (RATA) and irregular salary and Extraordinary and Miscellaneous Expenses (EME) disbursements.
